criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 computed for all seven PNGs from /tmp/fsrooms/gate-r18 with src/harnesses/_core/object_gate.pixel_sha256.
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: No side/iso faces. Ribs: front-facing shaft with lit-left ramp; brass bands and knobs have lit top row + darker front row; corbels show top face + tapering underside; cornice ledge shows top face then shaded front. Shell/cornice are surface patterns.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Every colour in the seven pieces already occurs in the v5 sheet. 1px dark outline on wood, 4-step wood ramp, grain dashes and knots, brick textures with mortar - no flat-filled blobs. Corbel greys are slightly cooler than the wall stone but match existing v5 stone trim.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: In mock-obs.png at 1x the inward-leaning ribs, brass-capped tips stepping up toward the north wall and the darkening cornice/shell band read as a round domed hall with ribs, not random poles. Centre ribs straight to the map top.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Corbels sit on the wall-face baseline; top tiles join the rib tops exactly (columns verified); rib top cells reproduce the cornice pattern, so no seams against neighbouring cornice tiles. No floating or clipping.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Non-shaft pixels of every rib/top tile checked against the plain cornice/shell tiles: identical, so no stray pixels or stubs. Curves step monotonically by 1px; knobs fully outlined.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 갈빗대(가운데, 1×3) (dome rib)
reasons: 3/4 ok: straight 6px shaft (outline + C/D/E/F wood ramp, light left) on the wall face, two 2-row brass bands with lit top row (top face) and darker lower row, stone corbel with lit top row and tapering underside.
Top 16px reproduce the dome-cornice pattern pixel-for-pixel outside the shaft, so it tiles seamlessly into the cornice band; shaft runs off the top edge cleanly at the map's top row.
All 24 colours are existing v5 sheet colours (wood ramp = bookcase ramp; corbel = sheet stone-step greys). Grain dashes (F) and single knot (S) give texture, no flat fill.

At 1x in the mock it reads as a wooden rib with brass rings standing on the north wall; grounded on the corbel at the wall base, no float. Minor: corbel is cooler/lighter than the wall stone, acceptable since it echoes the existing grey base trim.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 갈빗대(서쪽 벽, 가운데로 휨, 1×3) (dome rib west)
reasons: Same construction as the centre rib; wall-face shaft straight at x=2..7, then bends east monotonically through the cornice cell (x=2 rows 10-15, x=3 rows 4-9, x=4 rows 0-3) and leaves the top edge at x=4..9, matching the top-west tile's bottom row exactly.
Background in the top 16px is the cornice pattern with no stray pixels (checked every non-shaft pixel against dome_cornice).
Light stays top-left (C highlight on west side). Corbel x=0..9 centred on shaft, grounded at wall base.
In the 1x room mock the west ribs lean toward the centre and, with the top tiles, read as ribs of a dome curving overhead rather than random poles.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 갈빗대(동쪽 벽, 가운데로 휨, 1×3) (dome rib east)
reasons: Exact horizontal mirror of the west rib's silhouette (shaft x=8..13, bending to x=6..11 at the top edge) while keeping the C->F light-left ramp, as specified.
Continuity with dome_rib_top_east verified: top row x=6..11 meets the top tile's bottom-row shaft x=6..11.
Cornice background pixels outside the shaft identical to dome_cornice; no stubs. Corbel x=6..15 grounded.
Reads at 1x as an inward-leaning dome rib on the east side of the stepped hall.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 갈빗대 끝(서쪽, 천장 줄 1칸) (dome rib top west)
reasons: Shell pattern reproduced exactly around the shaft. Shaft continues the curve (left edge 4,5,5,5,6,6,7,7,7,7,8 going up), narrows from 6 to 5 px at row 11/12 (LMN instead of LMON), ends in an outlined 6x6 brass knob at x=8..13 rows 1-5 whose interior has a lit top (F/G/G/G, G/H/H/I) and darker front row (J/J/J/K) - a 3/4 cap, not a flat square.
Single-pixel stair steps of the curve are standard 16px practice and read as a smooth bend at 1x; no orphan pixels.
Knob does not touch the tile's top edge (row 0 is untouched shell), so stacked shell rows above stay seamless.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 갈빗대 끝(동쪽, 천장 줄 1칸) (dome rib top east)
reasons: Exact mirror of the top-west tile (shaft left edge 6,5,5,5,5,5,4,4,4,3 going up, knob x=2..7) with light kept on the left of the shaft and on the knob's top-left.
Bottom-row shaft x=6..11 matches dome_rib_east's top row; shell pattern around it is pixel-identical to dome_shell.
Reads at 1x as the brass-capped tip of a rib curving west into the dome.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 돌 처마 띠(천장 줄 1칸, 벽면 바로 위) (dome cornice)
reasons: Seamless horizontally (7px bricks wrap across the seam in all three courses) and vertically (shell's mortar row 15 meets cornice brick row 0).

Bricks are the sheet's dark stone greys (55,53,56)/(67,63,70), two clear steps darker than the wall-face stone; running bond with offset joints. The ledge (rows 11-15) is a lit top row (118,110,116) stepping down to (30,30,36) - a 3/4 ledge with visible top face and shaded front, consistent with the grey wall-top trim already in v5.

In the room it reads as the wall's top cornice where the masonry starts curving inward. Minor note: the bricks themselves are flat single fills without highlight, but the existing v5 wall bricks are drawn the same way, so it fits.

items.name: 둥근 지붕 안쪽 면(천장 줄 1칸, 처마 위) (dome shell)
reasons: 4x3 bricks (3px + 1px mortar) in three dark tones (29,33,40)/(35,39,44)/(46,38,48), all existing sheet colours, darker and smaller than the cornice bricks - the band darkens and fines upward as intended.
Tiles seamlessly in both axes (bricks wrap across x=15/0, mortar row at 15).
As a pure surface tile there is no 3/4 issue; in the mock the shell+cornice band reads as the inside of a dome receding overhead behind the ribs.
